# HUDERA AI (هوديرا)

> HUDERA AI is an AI company serving Saudi Arabia, the Gulf, Jordan and Egypt. It builds "AI employees": assistants that work inside WhatsApp in Arabic and English for HR, collections, sales and operations, plus dashboards, van-sales apps and workflow automation. Every sensitive decision is approved by a person. HUDERA AI also runs HUDERA Academy, a practical AI course in Egyptian Arabic, Gulf Arabic and English.

Not to be confused with HUDERIA (the Council of Europe's AI risk methodology).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://hudera.ai/): services, demos, pricing, about, contact
- [HUDERA Academy](https://hudera.ai/academy/): practical AI course (Arabic and English)
- [Careers](https://hudera.ai/careers/): open full-time roles
- [Privacy](https://hudera.ai/privacy.html)
